text: With scope locked, it's time to choose the stack: AWS, Amazon EKS, Amazon ECR, Terraform, GitHub Actions, and Prometheus and Grafana.
checkout-api's traffic spikes hard during ticket on-sales -- that's exactly why EKS wins over a simpler platform-as-a-service here.
Terraform defines the VPC, the EKS cluster, ECR repositories, and an RDS Postgres database -- all reviewable before anything real changes.
GitHub Actions runs the pipeline since the code already lives on GitHub; Prometheus and Grafana give real control over what gets measured and alerted on.
Next: designing the real AWS infrastructure this stack gets built on.
